title: Held-out behaviour scenarios
goal: Rule changes are judged on scenarios not used while drafting them
acceptance: rule-review.md: drafts never edit or tune against held-out scenarios; a drop before/after is a regression record
privacy: Rule and procedure text only; fixtures are invented repositories; no personal data.
escalation: Rule text differing materially from the accepted draft goes back to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: a setting, a list marker and procedure text. Not a measurement.
